goal: Unify single-threaded and multithreaded block script verification to make validation code easier to audit
Ensure block validity checks populate the script execution cache consistently across all worker thread counts
agreement: Broad concept support for unifying and simplifying block script verification (theuni, sedited, Eunovo)
Unaddressed objection: mixing behavior changes with structural refactoring risks consensus bugs (l0rinc)
Support and full approval after testing the simplified script verification flow (Eunovo)
